summary: Build practical tendering, procurement and negotiation skills through bid evaluation and supplier exercises. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Procurement training prepares procurement officers, buyers and contract specialists to structure sourcing decisions and document supplier selection. Participants practise defining needs, designing solicitations, comparing bids with weighted scoring and total cost of ownership, and planning supplier negotiations using BATNA, alongside drafting award records and contract handover documents.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for professionals who prepare, assess or approve supplier sourcing decisions and need a consistent tendering process.
prerequisites: No procurement qualification is specified as a prerequisite. Familiarity with workplace purchasing or supplier documents may help; no coding or programming is required.
